children: KoskiRent Plc | Stock Exchange Release | August 31, 2026 at 16:15:00 EEST

KoskiRent Plc has appointed Jirka Laukkanen as a member of the Group Management Team as of 1 September 2026, with responsibility for the company's project operations. He will report to CEO Mika Koski and will be based at the company's Tampere office.

Jirka Laukkanen has been employed by KoskiRent Plc since 2023. He holds a Bachelor of Construction Management (B.Eng.) degree and has extensive experience in project management and a broad background in the construction sector. Prior to joining KoskiRent, he served as a Project Manager at Adapteo Finland Oy and has acted as the lead project manager on dozens of modular construction projects throughout his career.
Following the appointment, the members of KoskiRent Plc's Group Management Team are:

KoskiRent Plc is a Finnish service company, established in 2013, specialising in rental solutions and space services for the public sector under the Modulo brand. We design healthy, sustainable, and adaptable facilities—built by our trusted subcontractor network and owned, leased, and managed by us for medium and long-term use. Our relocatable modular spaces, used mainly as schools and kindergartens, provide flexible, efficient, and sustainable space solutions tailored to meet the diverse needs of users. KoskiRent Plc currently operates 22 units across Finland. The facilities meet the same standards as permanent construction while offering municipalities greater flexibility, faster delivery, more cost-efficient use of resources, and adaptability throughout their life cycle.
